configurations.//: ABSOLUTE path on purpose. The project moved from C: to D: and a preview session kept the old working directory, so `node server.mjs` silently served the STALE C: copy — same URL, same port, old code. server.mjs resolves its static files, .env and data dir from __dirname (import.meta.url), never from cwd, so naming the file absolutely pins the whole server to this checkout no matter where it is launched from.

STATIC-ONLY. Serves the front end without a backend, for checking that app.js parses and the UI renders when Node is unavailable. /api/* returns 404 here — use the 'firas' entry for anything that talks to the server.
